title: Web Information Gathering Workflow
description: Initial access sequence: fingerprinting → directory enumeration → leak discovery → parameter discovery
detail:
Perform steps in order and record each output as a service/loot fact:
1. Fingerprinting: whatweb / response headers / favicon hash (Wappalyzer rules)
2. robots.txt / sitemap.xml / .well-known/
3. Directory enumeration: dirsearch (or gobuster); focus on: /admin /login /api /backup /upload
4. Leaks: .git/ .svn/ .DS_Store .env .bak .swp swagger druid actuator
5. JS analysis: use jsfinder to extract endpoints and hardcoded keys
6. Parameters: OPTIONS, hidden parameters (arjun)
Principle: determine the version from fingerprinting → search directly for the corresponding CVE (see the CVE quick-reference entry); when a leak is found, go straight to loot.
